#1
धर्मक्षेत्रे|dharma-kṣetre|dharma — sacred duty, the right order (here: 'of dharma', first member of the compound);;kṣetra — field (loc. sg. kṣetre: 'on the field')
कुरुक्षेत्रे|kuru-kṣetre|Kuru — the Kuru clan, ancestors of both sides;;kṣetra — field (loc. sg.: 'on the field of the Kurus')
समवेता|samavetāḥ|samavetā — assembled, gathered (past participle of sam-ava-i; nom. pl. masc.; final -ḥ dropped before the following y-)
युयुत्सवः|yuyutsavaḥ|yuyutsu — wanting to fight (desiderative adjective from yudh 'fight'; nom. pl. masc.)
--
मामकाः|māmakāḥ|māmaka — mine, my people (nom. pl. masc.)
पाण्डवाश्चैव|pāṇḍavāḥ ca eva|pāṇḍava — son of Pāṇḍu, a Pāṇḍava (nom. pl.; -āḥ + c- becomes -āś c-);;ca — and;;eva — indeed, just (ca + eva fuse to caiva)
किमकुर्वत|kim akurvata|kim — what?;;kṛ — to do (akurvata: imperfect middle, 3rd pl. 'they did')
संजय|saṃjaya|Saṃjaya — Sañjaya, the blind king's minister and narrator (vocative)
#2
दृष्ट्वा|dṛṣṭvā|dṛś — to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund, 'having seen')
तु|tu|tu — but, now (particle)
पाण्डवानीकं|pāṇḍava-anīkam|pāṇḍava — Pāṇḍava, son of Pāṇḍu;;anīka — army, battle-array (acc. sg.; -a + a- fuse to -ā-)
व्यूढं|vyūḍham|vyūḍha — drawn up in battle order (past participle of vi-ūh; acc. sg. neut.)
दुर्योधनस्तदा|duryodhanaḥ tadā|Duryodhana — the eldest Kaurava, leader of the hundred sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra (nom. sg.; -aḥ + t- becomes -as t-);;tadā — then
--
आचार्यमुपसंगम्य|ācāryam upasaṃgamya|ācārya — teacher (acc. sg.; here Droṇa, who trained both families);;upa-sam-gam — to approach (upasaṃgamya: gerund, 'having gone up to')
राजा|rājā|rājan — king (nom. sg.)
वचनमब्रवीत्|vacanam abravīt|vacana — speech, words (acc. sg.);;brū — to speak (abravīt: imperfect, 3rd sg. 'he spoke')
#3
पश्यैतां|paśya etām|dṛś/paś — to see (paśya: imperative 2nd sg. 'look!');;etad — this (etām: acc. sg. fem.; -a + e- fuse to -ai-)
पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य|pāṇḍu-putrāṇām ācārya|Pāṇḍu — Pāṇḍu, father of the five Pāṇḍavas;;putra — son (gen. pl. 'of the sons of Pāṇḍu');;ācārya — teacher (vocative: 'O teacher')
महतीं|mahatīm|mahat — great (acc. sg. fem.)

--

#4

भीमार्जुनसमा|bhīma-arjuna-samāḥ|Bhīma — Bhīma, second Pāṇḍava, the strong one;;Arjuna — Arjuna, third Pāṇḍava;;sama — equal (nom. pl.: 'equal to Bhīma and Arjuna')

#5

#8
